forward_patch:
--- original
+++ modified
@@ -0,0 +1,36 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '8880'
+title: 'ACPA-23 (D203): three bundled profiles large, medium, small, and the README 16 GB minimum'
+---
+Decision D203 in `TestudoApp/features/decisions.md` (commit 4ab65e8). The user said (2026-11-18): "small medium large, 16G minimum", and "yes on small". Brief: `/Users/wballard/github/swissarmyhammer/.briefs/profiles/acpa-brief.md`, parts 1 and 6. Facts and sizes: `research.md` in the same folder. Overview: `overview.md`.
+
+## Dependencies
+
+None.
+
+## Current state
+
+- Two bundled profiles: `Resources/profiles/large.yaml` (Qwen3.8-27B 8-bit with the MTP drafter, 8-bit) and `Resources/profiles/small.yaml` (Qwen3.8-27B 4-bit with the MTP drafter).
+- `BundledProfiles.defaultName = "large"` (`Configuration/BundledProfiles.swift:18`), `names = [defaultName, "small"]` (`:21`).
+- The README says that the agent needs 32 GB (`README.md:67-71`) and lists two profiles (`README.md:80-95`).
+
+## Change
+
+1. `medium.yaml`: the content of the current `small.yaml` (Qwen3.8-27B 4-bit with `Qwen3.8-27B-MTP-4bit`). The description names "a Mac with 32 GB".
+2. New `small.yaml`: `standard` and `flash` are `{repo: mlx-community/Qwen3.5-9B-4bit, drafter: mlx-community/Qwen3.5-9B-MTP-4bit}`, and `kvBits: 8`. The `embedding` and `decision` keys come from `large`. The description names "a Mac with 16 GB or 24 GB".
+3. `large.yaml`: the description names "a Mac with 48 GB or more".
+4. `BundledProfiles.names = ["large", "medium", "small"]`, from the largest to the smallest. Keep `defaultName` only as the base of the merge of profile files (`baseKeys`, `BundledProfiles.swift:25-30`), or rename it to make this clear. (The default of the selection becomes the fit choice in a later task.)
+5. README: "The agent needs a Mac with 16 GB of memory or more." A table of the three profiles with the models, the download size (33.9 GB, 19.3 GB, 9.4 GB, with the embedding and decision models; see `research.md`) and the target memory. Name the 32K-token minimum window. The text about the default, the migration and the warning comes with those tasks.
+6. Do not change `kvBits` of `large` or `medium` (a separate task measures it and asks the user).
+
+## Tests
+
+- `BundledProfiles.all` has `large`, `medium` and `small` in this order, and each decodes.
+- `small` has the Qwen3.5-9B repo, its MTP drafter and `kvBits: 8`.
+- `medium` has the models of the old `small`.
+- Update each test that expects the old two profiles.
+
+When this lands, push to origin/main and send the sha to the TestudoApp session (testudoapp-9a). #d203 #profiles #acpa-23
\ No newline at end of file
